verdict.rationale: Fireworks is fundamentally API-first (inference, fine-tuning, deployment, uploads, batch, LoRA management all documented as API/CLI operations via firectl and REST endpoints), and the UI largely mirrors these same operations rather than offering exclusive functionality. However, there's no explicit statement confirming full UI/API parity or an OpenAPI spec confirming API completeness, and the probe found no discoverable OpenAPI spec (404s), leaving some ambiguity about whether every UI action (e.g. guided fine-tuning wizard, dashboard analytics) has a direct API equivalent. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, published OpenAPI spec confirming full API surface, evidence that dashboard-only features (e.g. guided task wizard, benchmarking UI) are also API-accessible.
